concepts.title: Line Graph and Data Trends
concepts.definition: A visual display plotting continuous data points collected over uniform time intervals connected by line segments.
concepts.key_idea: Line graphs show continuous variations and trends over period of time.
question_patterns: find the change in temperature between initial time and final time
calculate the increase in quantity from the line graph
determine the trend difference between two recordings
what is the difference in values between two time periods
Read the temperature rise between two marks on the graph.

solution_steps.explain: subtract initial observed value from final observed value

concepts.title: Distance-Time Graph Interpretation
concepts.definition: A graphical representation plotting distance against elapsed time to track movement and determine speed.
concepts.key_idea: The slope of distance-time graph represents speed, and horizontal segments denote rest.
question_patterns: find the distance covered during a time interval
calculate speed from distance time data
how far did the object travel in the given hour
determine time required to cover a specified distance
A car covers 120 km in 2 hours -- what speed does the graph slope show?

solution_steps.explain: subtract initial position from final position
subtract start time from end time
divide distance covered by time taken

concepts.title: Independent and Dependent Variables
concepts.definition: One quantity you choose freely (it drives the graph); the other answers to it.
concepts.key_idea: The chosen one rides the x-axis; the answering one rides the y-axis.
question_patterns: spot which quantity is the independent variable when plotting the graph
identify the independent variable in the given situation
which variable is dependent on the other
explain the choice of axes for the variables
determine which quantity controls the other
In a cost-vs-units graph, which variable is chosen freely?

solution_steps.explain: the variable that is set independently or changes freely is the independent variable on x-axis
the quantity that varies as a consequence is the dependent variable on y-axis

concepts.title: Linear Graph of Direct Variation
concepts.definition: A straight-line graph passing through the origin representing two quantities that vary in direct proportion.
concepts.key_idea: Direct proportional relationships form unbroken straight lines passing through origin.
question_patterns: calculate total cost for a given quantity from unit cost
find quantity purchased for a specific total cost
compute unit price from total cost and quantity
determine proportional cost for target quantity
At 25 per kg, what does 6 kg cost? Sketch the line.

solution_steps.explain: divide total cost by initial quantity
multiply unit price by target quantity

concepts.title: Principal and Simple Interest Linear Relationship
concepts.definition: At a fixed yearly rate, the charge earned grows in a straight line with the sum deposited.
concepts.key_idea: Simple interest varies directly with the principal deposit when rate and time remain fixed.
question_patterns: calculate simple interest on a given principal
find required principal to obtain target interest
what is the interest earned for annual deposit
compute deposit needed for given interest rate and time
Find the yearly charge on 12000 at 8 percent.

solution_steps.explain: apply simple interest formula using principal, rate, and time

concepts.title: Geometric Graphs: Linear vs Non-Linear
concepts.definition: Comparison of geometric measure graphs where side length yields a linear graph for perimeter but a non-linear graph for area.
concepts.key_idea: Perimeter scales linearly with side length, whereas area scales quadratically resulting in a curve.
question_patterns: calculate perimeter of square for given side
calculate area of square for given side
determine whether perimeter vs side forms a linear graph
is area vs side graph linear or non linear
Does the side-vs-area picture bend or stay straight?
